text:
𝗦𝗥𝗜 𝗟𝗔𝗡𝗞𝗔 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗠𝗣𝗜𝗢𝗡𝗦! 🏆

Sri Lanka Women beat Ireland by 6 wkts in the Emerging Nations Trophy final in Ajman.
Sandeepani 4/13, Dulani 44* off 25. Unbeaten all tournament.

Best women's side outside the top 8? 👇
#WomensCricket #Cricket

👉 Emerging Nations Trophy final mein Sri Lanka Women ne Ireland ko 6 wickets se haraya
👉 Ireland 96 pe all out, Sandeepani ke 4/13
👉 Dulani ne 25 gend mein 44* thokkar chase 12.4 over mein khatam kiya
👉 Poore tournament mein unbeaten rahi Sri Lanka
